movie.title: UFC Fight Night 285: Hernandez vs. Rodrigues
movie.originalTitle: UFC Fight Night 285: Hernandez vs. Rodrigues
movie.overview: UFC Fight Night 285: Hernandez vs. Rodrigues was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on August 22, 2026, at the Golden 1 Center in Sacramento, California, United States. A middleweight bout between former LFA Middleweight Champions Anthony Hernandez and Gregory Rodrigues headlined the event.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Anthony Hernandez faces Gregory Rodrigues in a marquee middleweight showdown headlining UFC Fight Night 285 in Sacramento, California.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: UFC Fight Night 285 features a high-stakes middleweight main event between former LFA Middleweight Champions Anthony Hernandez and Gregory Rodrigues. Broadcast live from the Golden 1 Center in Sacramento, California, the event brings intense mixed martial arts action to the octagon. Both fighters enter the cage seeking to make a decisive statement and climb the divisional rankings. Fans are treated to a action-packed night highlighting top-tier talent and dramatic finishes.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: UFC Fight Night 285 brings world-class mixed martial arts to the Golden 1 Center in Sacramento, California. The event is anchored by a compelling middleweight clash between Anthony Hernandez and Gregory Rodrigues, two former LFA Middleweight Champions with explosive fighting styles. Hernandez looks to utilize his relentless pace and grapple-heavy skill set to control the contest. Rodrigues relies on his devastating knockout power and high-level Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu to counter his opponent's relentless pressure. As the main event unfolds, both combatants push through adversity in a grueling tactical battle. The broader fight card showcases an array of rising prospects and seasoned veterans aiming for career-defining victories. Throughout the evening, dynamic striking exchanges and high-stakes submission attempts capture the crowd's energy. Ultimately, the event delivers an electrifying showcase of athletic endurance, martial arts mastery, and high-stakes drama.
